title: Input of scripts/figs/fig_frontier.py: a two-panel trade-off (frontier) figure
description: One panel per edit log. Every series is one method (an id of scripts/figs/style.py: METHODS) with marked points and / or a traced curve; a point is a pair (x, y) of two rates in percent, optionally with intervals. The experiment code writes this file from its result JSON (proposed: 02_research/experiments/10_final/out/figs/frontier.json from E1_main.json); nothing in it is typed by hand. The script validates the same constraints with its own code (function validate), so the python package jsonschema is not needed.

synthetic.description: true ONLY for made-up example data. The figure then carries a watermark in every panel and can only be written below scripts/figs/example/; a file with real results must say false and must have 'source'.

title.description: one line, for the PDF metadata (not drawn)

source.description: provenance of real data: required unless synthetic

files.description: result JSON files, relative to project_3

log.description: name of the log in the testbed

title.description: panel title as printed (the paper name of the log)

method.description: an id of style.METHODS: rescope, rescope_where, cosine, ball, router, zscore, exact, comp_b, reedit_b, rb_union, rb_tot, linear, editor, dual

variant.description: default: the method's default calibration (filled marker); shared: one shared scale (half-filled marker); published: the gate at its published threshold (hollow marker). Only for methods with a filled marker.

curve.description: true: the points are joined in the order given (one point per calibration level)

label_point.description: index of the point that gets a direct label with the method's name (use for at most four series per panel)

level.description: calibration level of the point, if any

setting.description: setting of the result file (a05, default, fixed, nall, ...)

points.description: marked points, one per calibration level or one for a method without levels

trace.description: a curve without markers: one global threshold swept over a fine grid (PROTOCOL.md, amendment of 2026-11-11, E1b); the points of the same series lie on or beside it

metric.description: metric id of the result file, e.g. d1, ff, gen

label.description: axis label as printed, with the unit
